description: This file is a web page (index.html) that acts as the front-end interface for a Database Viewer application. It provides a user interface to browse databases, tables, and view table data with interactive features like refresh, expand cells, and responsive design. The embedded JavaScript manages fetching data from backend API endpoints, handles user interactions, and dynamically renders UI components.
external_methods: fetchData (fetch API calls to backend endpoints)
